title: Wi-Fi Hardware Time
subtitle: Persistent TSF · acquisition, conditional clocks and evidence gaps · 2026-10-08

routes.title: From Wi-Fi observations to conditional time
routes.summary: One persistent idle smoke and retained offline replay support different claims. Follow the observed diagnostic path into the tested model; the live admission and physical accuracy gates remain open.

nodes.label: Campaign controller
nodes.detail: Owns the adapter-scoped campaign lock and durable unfinished-run record. Fixed slots skip missed requests; report wait remains in the achieved cadence.

nodes.label: Persistent sampler
nodes.detail: A single 300-second idle smoke recorded 139 pending-to-success requests with normal closed-session evidence. This observation does not qualify cancellation, failure recovery or long-run load behavior.

nodes.label: Qualcomm + observer
nodes.detail: The exact-build diagnostic path records the TSF report and original ETW timestamp separately from reader receipt. Completion is not a sampling fence and this is not complete original-event export.

nodes.label: Offline screening
nodes.detail: Whole-recording screening accepts or rejects recorded candidates. Sample-screen-v2 closes a segment on suspected backward TSF; numerical ingestion alone does not establish causal online admission.

nodes.label: Conditional clock
nodes.detail: Exact bounded-rate arithmetic estimates station TSF at preserved event QPC. Smoke replay: 138 screened samples, 92.862589% tracking, 297/297 event-grid points settled. These are retained offline results.

nodes.label: Live consumer gate
nodes.detail: A future online admission state machine must establish complete, attributable, timely observations before the maintained consumer accepts them. AP/UTC and multi-device accuracy need independent evidence.

edges.label: fresh permit
edges.detail: A fresh sequential permit and owner recheck authorize one submission.

edges.label: action 4
edges.detail: Live smoke used the fixed action-4 request on the exact qualified build. Observed success is scoped to that capture.

edges.label: saved records
edges.detail: Raw receipts and trace records are retained before offline screening.

edges.label: screened replay
edges.detail: Replay is conditional on screening, association, capture-window and continuity assumptions.

edges.label: integration gate
edges.detail: An offline-screened sample stream is not an implemented online acquisition-admission contract.

unknowns: Establish causal online admission and application-observed availability.
Independently bound station/AP error before claiming AP-referenced accuracy.

routes.title: Guarded acquisition and durable evidence
routes.summary: Software controls around one request. Measured spacing includes report waits, identity checks and processing; a requested interval is not the achieved interval.

nodes.label: Campaign admission
nodes.detail: Create durable unfinished-run evidence before launching the worker. Quarantine is not automatically cleared by a restart or a new output directory.

nodes.label: Identity and readiness
nodes.detail: Validate startup identity, open the qualified handle and pin controller process creation time. A same-user local protocol is not an authentication boundary.

nodes.label: Monotonic schedule
nodes.detail: Persistent requested default is 1 second, minimum 0.5 seconds. Identity checks occur on a 30-second monotonic timer; heartbeat and observer pumping continue while waiting.

nodes.label: Submit one request
nodes.detail: The worker rechecks liveness immediately before submission under the admission mutex. At most one outstanding operation; preserve report wait.

nodes.label: Retain raw evidence
nodes.detail: Append raw snapshots and retain original request/session records. Flush/fsync and atomic replacement protect snapshots. Unknown schemas and contradictory lifecycle evidence reject.

nodes.label: Finalize campaign
nodes.detail: Final success requires persisted outcome, verified session closure, no outstanding I/O and final own-loss ratio at most 1%. A successful earlier request survives later session failure.

nodes.label: Stop and quarantine
nodes.detail: Any unresolved operation retains resources. Disk failure stops submissions. A collector restart does not establish firmware drain; reconciliation remains explicit.

edges.label: admit
edges.detail: Admission blocks unfinished or quarantined work.

edges.label: ready
edges.detail: Readiness follows validation and device opening.

edges.label: permit
edges.detail: Permit applies to one sequence only.

edges.label: retain
edges.detail: Record completion and report evidence without rewriting original timestamps.

edges.label: verify run
edges.detail: Final evidence and cleanup determine campaign outcome.

edges.label: on failure
edges.detail: Failure does not clear the unfinished-run or quarantine protection.

unknowns: Normal smoke shutdown does not qualify interruption, sleep, roam, reset or firmware drain.

routes.title: Completion controls resource release
routes.summary: An architecture view of the implemented request states. A finite poll does not bound the lifetime of pending I/O. Cancellation and deadlines remain sticky failures.

nodes.label: READY
nodes.detail: Session readiness follows identity validation. A new request uses fresh buffers, event and OVERLAPPED storage.

nodes.label: IN_FLIGHT
nodes.detail: Hold all operation resources until terminal completion is established. Poll waits are finite (at most 50 ms); the operation can remain pending indefinitely.

nodes.label: Terminal result
nodes.detail: A successful request is finalized only after terminal evidence processing and successful operation release. Earlier finalized requests survive later session failure.

nodes.label: STOPPED / close
nodes.detail: Verified operation release and handle-close bookkeeping gate closure. Never retry an ambiguous native close by numeric handle.

nodes.label: Retain and drain
nodes.detail: close() refuses release while unresolved. Worker owner loss or ordinary exceptions do not permit killing the worker or freeing its buffers.

nodes.label: Deadline / cancel
nodes.detail: A two-second deadline or any cancellation attempt fails the run even if later completion succeeds. ERROR_NOT_FOUND, WAIT_TIMEOUT and ERROR_IO_INCOMPLETE are not terminal proof.

edges.label: submit
edges.detail: Only one outstanding operation.

edges.label: terminal proof
edges.detail: Result query establishes a terminal result, unlike a timeout.

edges.label: stop / error
edges.detail: After verified release, stop path can close only with no outstanding I/O.

edges.label: clean success
edges.detail: Successful completion and release allow the next separately permitted request.

edges.label: deadline / stop
edges.detail: Deadline, owner loss or stop request enters a sticky failure path.

edges.label: not terminal
edges.detail: Cancellation request is not cancellation completion.

edges.label: terminal proof
edges.detail: Retain resources until terminal evidence and successful release; never reclassify the failed run as successful.

unknowns: Real cancellation, communication loss and recovery remain separately unqualified on hardware.

routes.title: Station TSF, host QPC and external clocks
routes.summary: Keep values, event placement and clock relationships distinct. The useful current result is conditional station-TSF estimation at an event QPC.

nodes.label: Associated AP TSF
nodes.detail: AP-referenced labeling additionally requires a station/AP equality or bounded-offset assumption. No independently measured station/AP error bound is established.

nodes.label: Station TSF value
nodes.detail: Diagnostic records supply a TSF value. Its interpreted quantization bin is [T, T+1] us; a true capture inside the host window remains an assumption.

nodes.label: Windows QPC
nodes.detail: QPC is the host interval coordinate. Preserve event QPC, request L, report U, completion C and reader receipt D as separate events.

nodes.label: Conditional interval
nodes.detail: Nominal rate is 1,000,000/F us per tick. Rate-only envelopes allow bounded instantaneous variation; a narrow interval is not calibrated absolute accuracy.

nodes.label: Application event
nodes.detail: Preserve the event coordinate and provisional result; append derived settlement later. Settlement wait affects finalization latency, not the raw event time.

nodes.label: UTC / multiple nodes
nodes.detail: Two individually narrow intervals do not imply the same pairwise accuracy. UTC requires an external reference chain and combined uncertainty budget.

edges.label: unproven offset
edges.detail: The station-to-AP clock relationship is a separate qualification gate.

edges.label: capture window
edges.detail: Capture inside [L,U+1] and association are assumptions; no simultaneous latch is proven.

edges.label: host coordinate
edges.detail: Exact envelope calculation relates accepted observations to QPC.

edges.label: query at Q
edges.detail: Integer estimate uncertainty includes the 0.5-us rounding allowance.

edges.label: accuracy gate
edges.detail: Physical reference evidence remains required.

unknowns: Capture timing and station/AP offset can have systematic bias despite numerical consistency.

routes.title: Capture, completion and availability
routes.summary: Dependency view, not a measured timeline: terminal I/O and report delivery may occur in either order. Availability is an analytical replay boundary.

nodes.label: L · request start
nodes.detail: L is recorded immediately before actual action-4 submission. Do not substitute the controller planned slot.

nodes.label: U · original report
nodes.detail: U is the original driver report timestamp. It is not reader delivery time; true firmware capture within the widened [L,U+1] interval remains conditional.

nodes.label: D · group available
nodes.detail: D is receipt of the delay record completing the required report group, not merely the first partial record.

nodes.label: A · replay boundary
nodes.detail: A_i=max(D_i,C_i,U_i+1). Arrival-order-v2 orders availability first and capture order for ties; skipped late historical captures are explicit.

nodes.label: C · terminal I/O
nodes.detail: C records actual terminal completion observation. An IOCTL return or cancellation request is not a firmware sampling fence.

nodes.label: Application availability
nodes.detail: The existing replay formula excludes later queueing, IPC and ingestion latency. A future live API must measure its actual exposed boundary and version changed semantics.

edges.label: host window
edges.detail: L and U form a conditional capture window, not a verified hardware sampling instant.

edges.label: async delivery
edges.detail: Delivery delay stays distinct from original logging time.

edges.label: required tail
edges.detail: Full required group receipt contributes to availability.

edges.label: terminal C
edges.detail: Completion can be before or after report receipt.

edges.label: widened U
edges.detail: Availability is at least one tick after the widened report endpoint.

edges.label: later boundary
edges.detail: No application-observed live latency claim follows from replay A.

unknowns: Causal online admission still needs a justified delivery watermark or bound.

routes.title: Screen first, check the frozen model, then update
routes.summary: Conditional offline replay with exact arithmetic. Acquisition evidence and numerical feasibility are different gates; the uncertainty threshold includes integer rounding.

nodes.label: Screen recording
nodes.detail: Offline screen uses action/order/vdev/delay arithmetic, a 2,000-us window and a separate 100-ppm freshness test. A suspected backward TSF closes the segment.

nodes.label: Order by availability
nodes.detail: Replay orders available samples causally and records skipped late historical captures. Provider ordering guards remain.

nodes.label: Frozen-model check
nodes.detail: Compute feasible capture extent against the prior c_low/c_high. A contradictory sample must not validate itself by first changing the model.

nodes.label: Intersect bounds
nodes.detail: c_low=max(T-a*(U+1)); c_high=min(T+1-b*L). Quantization widens both TSF and QPC intervals. Retain the +/-200-ppm rate prior.

nodes.label: Query event QPC
nodes.detail: Returned uncertainty = exact half-width + 0.5 us. tracking requires strictly less than 1,000 us; equality is stale. With no usable sample, acquiring. Holdover grows at 200 us per host second under this prior.

nodes.label: Latched invalid
nodes.detail: Incompatibility invalidates the current epoch. A later wider tolerance cannot reopen a screen-v2 continuity break. Causal invalidation waits until both compared observations are available.

edges.label: accepted data
edges.detail: Offline acceptance is not online acquisition admission.

edges.label: next sample
edges.detail: Respect arrival and capture ordering guards.

edges.label: compatible
edges.detail: Update only after frozen-model feasibility passes.

edges.label: query
edges.detail: Queries use only incorporated evidence available at the query boundary.

edges.label: contradiction
edges.detail: Latch invalid; explicit epoch handling required.

edges.label: epoch failure
edges.detail: Continuity loss is propagated at justified causal availability.

unknowns: Numerical compatibility does not prove physical capture time or report identity.

routes.title: Preserve the event and append a settled result
routes.summary: The immutable event survives both phases. Settlement-v2 requires a real before/after bracket and may narrow it with eligible overlapping envelopes.

nodes.label: Raw event record
nodes.detail: Capture and preserve raw event QPC. Never rewrite it to the time when analysis finishes.

nodes.label: Provisional result
nodes.detail: Return the then-available conditional interval and state. Preserve stale, acquiring or invalid outcomes honestly; settlement never edits the original response.

nodes.label: Wait for a bracket
nodes.detail: A complete bracket needs windows wholly before and after the preserved event. Overlapping capture windows cannot supply either bracket side.

nodes.label: Intersect envelopes
nodes.detail: Intersect the bracket and any eligible event-overlapping envelopes already available by settled_at_qpc. Record contributing sequences; do not use future evidence.

nodes.label: Derived settled record
nodes.detail: Append a separate result. Actual settled-grid maximum differs from retrospective adjacent-pair maximum. Smoke retained replay: 297/297 settled; max half-width 614.883 us; median wait 2.341 seconds.

nodes.label: Optional affine result
nodes.detail: Separate optional estimate assumes one constant rate in a span. Requires at least three available samples and observations on both sides; it does not replace the rate-only interval.

edges.label: preserve Q
edges.detail: Raw event and immediate provisional record remain immutable.

edges.label: pending
edges.detail: Wait for evidence without changing event time.

edges.label: complete pair
edges.detail: Overlap cannot substitute for a true bracket side.

edges.label: append result
edges.detail: Record cutoff and contributors at actual settlement.

edges.label: optional estimate
edges.detail: Stronger assumption is separately identified.

unknowns: Settled-grid counts do not establish continuous online service or independent AP accuracy.

routes.title: Diagnostic observations and missing original events
routes.summary: Static ownership evidence is useful, but an owned byte array is not yet an attributable complete timing event. These are separate routes and qualification boundaries.

nodes.label: Wi-Fi timing producer
nodes.detail: A live complete original-event export from the exact Wi-Fi timing producer is not demonstrated by the current path.

nodes.label: Adapter / protocol link
nodes.detail: Tie the active adapter and exact producer to the diagnostic endpoint, framing, lifecycle, original extent, loss and clock identity.

nodes.label: QUTS owned bytes
nodes.detail: Client deserialization allocates a byte array. This proves a software ownership mechanism in the inspected code, not a live connection to this Wi-Fi producer.

nodes.label: Complete-event contract
nodes.detail: Validate original bytes, source identity, validity, lifecycle and sampling semantics before using a diagnostic record as a clock input.

nodes.label: FTM aggregate result
nodes.detail: Ranging APIs return aggregate results. The full exchange needs local t2/t3 and matched peer t1/t4; aggregate RTT cannot supply clock offset.

nodes.label: Packet-log candidate
nodes.detail: A cursor can precede payload publication. Copying pointer-bearing wrappers or polling equal cursors does not establish owned coherent event bytes.

nodes.label: Retain diagnostics
nodes.detail: Keep useful evidence while the complete-event or timing contract is missing. Host logging time, API completion and hardware sampling are distinct.

edges.label: missing link
edges.detail: No demonstrated adapter-to-protocol connection.

edges.label: candidate path
edges.detail: A static client return path does not close producer binding.

edges.label: validate meaning
edges.detail: Byte ownership alone does not establish complete timing meaning.

edges.label: needs four times
edges.detail: Aggregate ranging remains insufficient for clock offset.

edges.label: copy / publication
edges.detail: Live coherence, ownership and original metadata remain separate requirements.

edges.label: missing evidence
edges.detail: Reject unqualified clock input while retaining diagnostic evidence.

nodes.label: Offline software
nodes.detail: Existing deterministic tests establish specific software decisions and exact arithmetic. This atlas build adds model/source and browser checks, not new radio evidence.

nodes.label: Conditional replay
nodes.detail: Retained smoke replay: 297/297 event-grid settlements; median/max rate-only half-width 280.429/614.883 us; median wait 2.341 seconds. Bounds and coverage are conditional, not physical error measurements.

nodes.label: Online admission
nodes.detail: Implement association, completeness, duplicate/foreign/loss handling, continuity and delivery boundaries without future-information leakage.

nodes.label: Physical qualification
nodes.detail: Independently establish capture semantics and station/AP uncertainty. Combined multi-node errors and UTC require separate budgets and reference chains.

nodes.label: Repository ownership
nodes.detail: wifi-hardware-time owns research and qualification; userspace-clock owns maintained APIs/providers. Proprietary captures, binaries and endpoint identifiers remain outside public Git. This atlas embeds only selected public authored files.
